note: Leads are optional or unresolved; none is a minimum obligation or was executed in this Goal. Source absence is not treated as proof of unsupported behavior.

leads.title: OME-Zarr derived-image interchange
leads.detail: Consider exporting masks or small derived images with axes/units after testing exact NGFF and Zarr versions. NGFF 0.5 is a useful geometry vocabulary [S1].

leads.title: napari canvas or plugin
leads.detail: Reuse documented lazy-layer, contrast, world-units, and shapes mechanisms if a custom canvas is too costly; project persistence and provenance remain application work [S2-S4].

leads.title: QuPath project/platform precedent
leads.detail: Keep QuPath's URI-based project entries and explicit export origin as useful reference; consider as platform only if whole-slide use becomes central [S14-S15].
leads.status: plausible alternative; not a v1 requirement

leads.title: Community issue and instrument-file monitoring
leads.detail: The tifffile #54 and #319 reports illustrate metadata/units failures; review issue history and fixtures for the group's actual instruments [S6-S11].
leads.status: process lead; no additional issue search established here

leads.title: CZI adapter and support claim
leads.detail: Do not repeat the seed claim that tifffile does not read CZI. The inspected README omits CZI, but the source-wide search was incomplete. Keep CZI outside proposed v1 by choice and investigate a reader adapter only if lab files require it [S5, S17-S18].
leads.status: external capability unresolved; v1 exclusion is a product choice

leads.title: GPU-assisted rendering/decoding
leads.detail: Keep rendering interfaces replaceable; measure CPU path first on the 8-core/16 GB target.

leads.title: GeoJSON interop semantics
leads.detail: QuPath documents pixel coordinates and warns that GeoJSON shapes can lose ellipse fidelity, but this Goal did not inspect RFC 7946 or test microscopy-coordinate consumers. Prefer a manifest-backed CSV/JSON contract until interop is validated [S15].

leads.title: ITK/SimpleITK coordinate model
leads.detail: A future registration path could compare origin/spacing/direction-cosine conventions; not investigated in this diagnostic.

leads.title: Assisted segmentation
leads.detail: Could be evaluated later if annotation throughput becomes limiting; keep suggested labels/overlays distinct from researcher-authored annotations and record provenance.

leads.title: OMERO or cloud exchange
leads.detail: Shared-storage bundles and references remain the v1 exchange path; cloud collaboration is a later alternative requiring separate governance and sync design.

leads.title: tifffile axis and coordinate helpers
leads.detail: The pinned README documents xarray/Zarr access examples; inspect current `coords`, `scale`, and `units` API against lab files before using these as authoritative calibration [S5-S6].
leads.status: implementation lead; unvalidated on team data

leads.title: napari undo/redo semantics
leads.detail: Selected napari docs do not establish undo persistence for this workflow. Keep annotation undo/redo in an application-owned command log unless release-specific behavior is separately verified [S4].
leads.status: explicitly unverified and not relied upon

leads.title: NDPI and BIF app support
leads.detail: tifffile 2026.9.20 documents NDPI reading and BIF tile decoding but not BIF stitching. Decide from the group's real slide workflows, not from an upstream-wide unsupported claim [S5-S6].
leads.status: v1 defer pending representative fixtures; reader capability is positive for documented cases

leads.title: VMS and other vendor formats
leads.detail: The reviewed tifffile README/source captures do not establish VMS behavior. Check the lab's exact files and a primary reader/API before deciding support.

leads.title: OME-Zarr version interoperability
leads.detail: A separate Zarr reader is required; test exact v0.4/v0.5 metadata, chunk access, units, and round trips before claiming compatibility. tifffile's TIFF-backed Zarr examples do not prove general OME-Zarr support [S1, S5-S6].
